releaseNotes:
Android: Implemented APK Signature Scheme v3/v3.1 rotation lineage to resolve package conflicts and preserve user data.
Android: Added multi-layer preflight checks for signature compatibility, downgrade prevention, and post-install version reconciliation.
Windows: Embedded native application icon directly into executable PE resources and runtime window frame.
Windows: Fixed UAC elevation update failure (os error 740) by launching installer with elevated ShellExecuteW runas verb.
Display Stream: Upgraded to full-resolution 4:4:4 chroma (SamplingFactor::F_1_1), base JPEG quality 82, and 60 FPS target with adaptive frame-rate shedding.
releaseHighlights: Android: Implemented APK Signature Scheme v3/v3.1 rotation lineage to resolve package conflicts and preserve user data.
